name: hiringcafe
description: Search active public job listings with HiringCafe, refine results, view job details, and compare selected jobs.

interface.longDescription: HiringCafe Job Search helps job seekers find active public job listings. Search by role, skills, location, workplace arrangement, compensation, employment type, experience, education, company, industry, funding, and posting date. Use it to start a new search or try a more precise approach when earlier results were too broad, too narrow, stale, or irrelevant. Review public job details and HiringCafe application links, or compare selected jobs in an interactive results display. The plugin is anonymous and read-only. It cannot submit applications or access HiringCafe accounts, saved jobs, resumes, profiles, or application history; users continue to HiringCafe to apply.
capabilities: Search active public job listings with a natural-language request
Narrow results by role, location, pay, experience, company, and other criteria
Review public job details and HiringCafe application links
defaultPrompt: Find remote senior frontend engineering jobs posted this week.
Show product jobs in New York paying at least $150,000.
